preview.tournamentOverview: Black Desert Resort Golf Course hosts the Bank of Utah Championship with a layout that heavily favors off-the-tee play. The course weights driving distance and accuracy at 33% combined, while approach play and short game receive lighter emphasis at 6% and 7% respectively. This event serves as a key stop for players seeking to build FedExCup points and improve their season-long standing.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model assigns 33% weight to strokes gained off-the-tee, making driving performance the dominant factor this week. Approach play carries 6% weight while putting receives only 4%, reflecting the course's emphasis on ball-striking over short-game execution. Bogey avoidance and birdie-bogey ratio each receive 3% weight, highlighting the importance of consistent scoring over raw birdie-making ability.
preview.pickApproach: We prioritize players with strong off-the-tee metrics given the 33% SG OTT weighting, followed by those who excel in approach play. We tier selections by combining course-specific weights with recent performance trends to identify the strongest betting opportunities.
